description:
Maintenance release for documentation, diagnostics, attribution, and licensing notices. The successful-patching behavior is unchanged.

Independent third-party bundle maintained by **gggg-unit**, compatible with Morphe. Not affiliated with or endorsed by SD Maid SE, d4rken, the Morphe project, Doom, or Paresh.

The GitHub/FOSS build uses an honor-based support model. Its normal upgrade flow does not verify payment; this patch forces the local feature state. It does not unlock the Google Play distribution or make the user a sponsor. See the [developer’s explanation](https://github.com/d4rken-org/sdmaid-se/discussions/536), and please [support d4rken](https://github.com/sponsors/d4rken).

Changes:
- Embed `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, and `licenses/` in the `.mpp` and verify their contents during the build.
- Preserve credits, reference revisions, branding terms, and disclaimers.
- Use an independent bundle name.
- Shorten the README and move build/testing details to a separate document.
- Explain unsupported APK and missing-fingerprint failures, and add a diagnostic issue form.
- Keep the repository bundle synchronized with the published release.

Validation: patch application and injected-bytecode checks passed on official GitHub FOSS APKs v2.1.0-rc0, v2.2.0-rc0, v2.2.1-rc0, and v2.2.2-rc0. The workflow also checks the latest official FOSS release daily. The maintainer reported successful use of v0.1.0 on Android; device/Android details were not provided.

Download `patches-0.1.1.mpp` and select **Unlock Pro (FOSS)**. Google Play APKs are unsupported. [README](https://github.com/gggg-unit/sdmaid-se-morphe-patch#readme) · [NOTICE](https://github.com/gggg-unit/sdmaid-se-morphe-patch/blob/main/NOTICE)
